name: Ring with a Scarab Bezel
description: Palette extracted from “Ring with a Scarab Bezel” by Ancient Egyptian (Second Intermediate Period, Dynasty 15 (about 1650–1550 BCE)), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 594. 3–5 semantic variants, glass/glitch effects.
changelog: 1.1.0 — source-backed design object palette; 3–5 variants; glass or glitch.
